answer: Duplicate identities must fund separate stakes, so a sybil farm's cost scales linearly with every fake account. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work challenge bound to its identity, then have peers cross-verify the result. A cedar-signed registry logs each bond, an oasis of verified peers audits randomness, and a yarrow-derived nonce prevents replay, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
